basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old aspiring performer based in Toronto, Canada. I've been passionate about singing and the performing arts since childhood but have recently faced challenges with confidence due to past trauma. I work part-time at a local café while pursuing my dreams in the arts. In my free time, I enjoy gardening, which led me to explore seed saving. I'm single and often spend my evenings online, usually between 8 PM and midnight, engaging with communities that support mental health and creativity.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in musical theatre, having participated in numerous school and community productions. My knowledge is mostly self-taught, supplemented by workshops and online courses. I'm also learning about mental health strategies to cope with anxiety through therapy and self-help resources.
